description: Lose one server on the HA cluster built and loaded as in e2e3a.build and e2e3a.workload: stop e2e-k2 with stop_vm. Pass: 2 of 3 nodes stay Ready, a typed ConfigMap write and read succeed, the service still answers on the surviving servers; after start_vm, e2e-k2 is Ready and an etcd member again.

inputs.agentA: the dev VM's production-style system unit opute-bootstrap-mcp.service (Rust 0.4.0 release candidate binary, test identity e2e-devvm-agent, test token), with the Rust k3s provider 1.0.2 from the release (e2e-provider-k3s, port 4320)
inputs.agentB: a transient Rust agent e2e-ha-b on port 3031 (e2etool agent start), with its own Rust k3s provider (e2e-provider-k3s-b, port 4321)
inputs.k3s: K3s v1.31.8+k3s1, downloaded by the provider from the K3s GitHub release and checked against its checksums; images pulled by K3s from public registries

requirements.spec: published docs, host-agents c9f9e775 (v0.2.4) site/public/docs/availability/ (test record 2026-09-25)
requirements.requirement: Three Incus server containers provisioned and configured through typed Host Agent operations as a K3s cluster with embedded-etcd
requirements.scenario: 3 Ready servers and 3 etcd members after joining through the sealed handshake
Secret-bearing input: the K3s join token reaches no Host Agent state, journal or client-visible record; it crosses hosts only sealed to the destination's key

requirements.requirement: install_cluster_package, put_cluster_secret, exec_cluster_command and list_services on the HA cluster
requirements.scenario: A Helm chart installed, a secret put, a command run in a pod, and the service exposed inside the VM answering HTTP on every server
Secret-bearing input: the secret's value is in no result; its key is read back without it

requirements.requirement: list_secret_keys returns a Secret's key names, never values
requirements.scenario: The goal's pass check (D32, answering Q18): the put secret's key is listed by name, never its value; an unknown Secret is a typed error naming it

requirements.requirement: list_configmap_keys returns a ConfigMap's key names, never values
requirements.scenario: A ConfigMap's keys come back sorted, without its values (D33)

requirements.requirement: inspect_workload returns a fixed projection of one Deployment
requirements.scenario: The Deployment's replicas, readiness and containers come back; its env names a literal variable and a secret reference without either value (D34)

requirements.spec: published docs, host-agents c9f9e775 (v0.2.4) site/public/docs/availability/ (test record 2026-09-25)
requirements.requirement: After one guest stopped, 2 of 3 Kubernetes nodes remained Ready and a typed API write and read succeeded; starting the guest restored 3 of 3 Ready nodes
requirements.scenario: One Incus guest/server failure on one physical host, stopped and started through typed calls

requirements.spec: published docs, host-agents c9f9e775 (v0.2.4) site/public/docs/availability/ (test record 2026-09-25)
requirements.requirement: Application serving is recorded separately from control-plane writes
requirements.scenario: The service answers 10 consecutive rounds on both surviving servers within 120 s of the server being NotReady (beyond the page's tested scope; recorded, with the time it took)

steps.guest: chown -R opute /home/opute/.config/opute-e2e && for p in 4320:e2e-provider-k3s 4321:e2e-provider-k3s-b; do systemd-run --collect --unit=${p#*:} --uid=opute --gid=opute --setenv=HOME=/home/opute --setenv=OPUTE_PROVIDER_PORT=${p%%:*} --property=Restart=no /opt/opute-e2e/providers/opute-provider-k3s || exit 1; done && python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/e2etool.py agent start b --port 3031 --id e2e-ha-b --env OPUTE_STANDALONE_ALLOW_MUTATIONS=true --env MCP_AUTH_TOKEN='${SECRET:tokenB}' >/dev/null && for i in $(seq 60); do ss -ltnH 'sport = :4320' | grep -q . && ss -ltnH 'sport = :4321' | grep -q . && break; sleep 0.5; done; ss -ltnH '( sport = :4320 or sport = :4321 )' | wc -l

python3 -c 'import sys, time, json; sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/opute-e2e/guest"); import mcpwire
for i in range(120):
    r = mcpwire.mcp(3014, sys.argv[1], "tools/list", request_id=i + 1)
    names = [t["name"] for t in ((r.get("body") or {}).get("result") or {}).get("tools") or []]
    if "opute.capability.kubernetes.provision" in names: break
    time.sleep(0.5)
print(json.dumps({"listed": "opute.capability.kubernetes.provision" in names, "tools": len(names), "polls": i + 1}))' '${TOKEN}'

arguments.manifest:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: e2e-during-failure
  namespace: e2e-web
data:
  written: during-k2-down

steps.guest: start=$(date +%s); n=0; while [ $n -lt 10 ] && [ $(( $(date +%s) - start )) -lt 120 ]; do ok=1; for ip in ${K1_IP} ${K3_IP}; do code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 5 http://$ip:30080/); [ "$code" = 200 ] || ok=0; done; if [ $ok = 1 ]; then n=$((n+1)); else n=0; fi; sleep 1; done; printf '{"consecutive": %d, "seconds": %d}' $n $(( $(date +%s) - start ))

cleanup.guest: systemctl stop e2e-provider-k3s e2e-provider-k3s-b 2>/dev/null; python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/e2etool.py agent remove b >/dev/null; for n in e2e-k1 e2e-k2 e2e-k3; do incus delete -f $n 2>/dev/null; done; incus storage volume list default -f csv | awk -F, '$1=="image"{print $2}' | xargs -r -I{} incus storage volume delete default image/{}; rm -rf /home/opute/.config/opute-e2e /opt/opute-e2e/providers; true
